newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH NOV TIMBER CUTTINGS UP 89 PCT - METLA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH NOV TIMBER CUTTINGS UP 89 PCT - METLA.

text.p: Raw timber cuttings in private Finnish forests rose 89 percent and timber markings rose 63 percent year-on-year in November, the Finnish Forest Research Institute (METLA) said in two monthly reviews on Thursday.
The forest industry purchased a total of 4.8 million cubic metres of raw wood in November, down 2.4 million cubic metres from the October record level, METLA said.
Timber cuttings in January-November fell 17 percent year-on-year to 29.2 million cubic metres it said.
Markings of timber in private forests rose to 4.8 million cubic metres in November, the institute said.
But total timber markings for January-November, amounting to 21.7 million cubic metres, were 23 percent lower than last year, it said.
